title: Monitoring & Observability — Know Which Station Failed
key_insight: Logs record events, metrics summarize trends, and traces connect the steps of one request. Together they make the route inspectable.
body:
## Know Which Station Failed

Users report slow wrong answers, but one final error count cannot show whether retrieval, the model, or a tool caused them.

Logs record events, metrics summarize trends, and traces connect the steps of one request. Together they make the route inspectable.

Start with user-visible success, errors, latency, and cost. Add component detail that helps explain those outcomes.
common_mistakes: One final error count identifies every root cause.
All user prompts should be logged forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Know Which Station Failed” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Observability connects user outcomes to requests, retrieval, models, tools, costs, and failures without exposing sensitive data.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Know Which Station Failed” to explain Monitoring & Observability plainly.
